motion.name: field-turn
motion.purpose: Continuous rotation of the mirrored field.

motion.name: shard-drift
motion.purpose: Autonomous recombination of the source geometry.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Starts paused; preference changes synchronize pause state. Play permits explicit motion.

layout.controls: bottom/right: max(18px, corresponding safe-area inset); gap: 8px
layout.canvas: Full viewport; pixel ratio capped at 2; source canvas capped at 1600px.

components.name: Artwork control
components.description: Subordinate native control for pause/play or image saving.
components.css: .ds-artwork-control { font: 13px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff5ff; background: #191331; border: 1px solid #706080; border-radius: 20px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-artwork-control:hover { background: #3a2855; border-color: #ffc7ed; } .ds-artwork-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffdb63; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Bright, playful shapes evolve autonomously into a mirrored field. This design applies only to artwork 055; Hypermedia Club's gallery and other independently styled works retain their own identities. Preserve the artwork's self-contained, dependency-free delivery.
dos: Do preserve bright, playful geometry and autonomous evolution.
Do keep controls legible and subordinate to the artwork.
Do preserve reduced-motion support and keyboard controls.
donts: Don't impose this artwork's palette or composition on the gallery or other pieces.
Don't introduce external fonts, libraries, or network dependencies.
